notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-small-4-0-26-03; og:url also lists /models/mistral-small-4-0-26-03). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, modalities tooltips, features, pricing), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header, modalities tooltips Text/Image input and Text output, Weights table Parameters/Active/Context). The description says 'hybrid model unifying instruct, reasoning, and coding' but does not name an architecture (e.g. MoE), so architecture and reasoningModes are not_stated. Blog post mistral-small-4-blog and Hugging Face benchmarks were not used; seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
